text: @so16tm/dsh-locale-ja 是面向 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的日语语言包，通过公开 locale API 注册日语词典，并在日语启用时应用适合日文的界面与代码字体。用户显式选择日语后，它还可加入日语回复提示；适合希望以日语操作 DSH 的用户。无需 API 密钥。
@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja adds Japanese translations and fonts to the DSH Web UI. When Japanese is explicitly selected, it can also prompt replies in Japanese. No API key is required.
想把 DSH 网页界面切换成日语。
有没有办法让设置菜单和聊天界面显示日文？
我想在 Web 版 DSH 里用日本語操作。
选择日语后，能否让助手的默认回答也用日语？
I want to use the DSH web interface in Japanese.
Can the assistant reply in Japanese when I select Japanese in settings?
@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja 的功能「日语界面词典」：注册日语语言和翻译词典，让 DSH Web 界面能够以日本語显示；通过 locale 服务管理词条，并将空白翻译留给英文回退。
@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja 的功能「日语字体适配」：日语启用时为界面和代码设置日文友好的字体栈；语言切换后同步增删样式，卸载时移除样式并取消订阅。
Japanese reply prompt: Selecting Japanese adds a reply instruction; replyInUiLanguage=false disables it.

@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja README · dsh-locale-ja：[English](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

A Japanese language plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI.

@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja README · Compatibility：Use this plugin with DSH's Web UI. Choose a compatible tag from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-locale-ja/releases); supported DSH versions and changes are recorded there and in [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md).

@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja README · Installation：Git and GitHub authentication with access to this private repository are required. Replace `<tag>` with your selected release tag. Prebuilt files are included; no local build is needed.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/so16tm/dsh-locale-ja.git#<tag>'
dsh web
```

These commands use the `web` profile. Omitting the tag installs `main`, which may contain unreleased changes.

@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja README · Installation：To update, run the same `add` command with the new release tag and restart `dsh web`. It replaces the installed version; you do not need to remove it first.

To remove:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @so16tm/dsh-locale-ja
```

Restart DSH after removal.

@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja README · Usage：Choose **日本語** in **Settings → General → Language**. The reply-language instruction takes effect on the next reply.

The instruction requires an explicit Japanese selection saved on the DSH host. It is not added when the language is chosen automatically by the browser or the host cannot save the selection, such as when accessing DSH from another PC on the LAN. Explicit requests for another reply language take precedence.

@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja README · Configuration：To disable the reply-language instruction, add this entry to the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: so16tm-locale-ja
  config:
    replyInUiLanguage: false
```

@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja README · Limitations：- Remove any other Japanese language plugin before enabling this one.
- Newly introduced DSH strings may remain in English until translations are added.

@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja README · Development：```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm check
```

`pnpm check` runs type checking, the build, tests, translation coverage, and release-note validation.

Follow the [translation guide](docs/translation-guide.md) when editing translations. The [DSH update workflow](.claude/skills/dsh-update/SKILL.md) (Japanese) covers extracting source strings, applying translations, checking compatibility, and releasing. See [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) (Japanese) for design constraints.

@so16tm/dsh-locale-ja README · Development：Commit the generated `lib/` files with source or translation changes. Update both READMEs when usage changes; record release-specific information in CHANGELOG.md.
